messages:
kelly: Heads-up I opened a PR to clean up the API reference for POST /v1/ingest. Multiple examples and SDK snippets are out of sync: some use `uid`, others `user_id`, and the schema currently marks `metadata` as required. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4456

omar: Reproduced. Staging accepts both `uid` and `user_id` today, but we should standardize to `user_id` in docs. Also the schema should be `metadata: nullable object` (or optional) not required.

zane: Suggestion: update the canonical example, add two variants (metadata object + metadata null), and include a one-line compatibility example for legacy clients. Example: 

```json
{
  "user_id": "alice",
  "content": "What's the ETA?",
  "metadata": {"env":"prod"}
}
```

and

```json
{
  "user_id": "alice",
  "content": "What's the ETA?",
  "metadata": null
}
```

kelly: Also updating the Node/Python snippets: Node uses `metadata: null` example, Python uses `metadata=None`. I'll add an explicit note: "Clients may omit `metadata` or set it to null; servers accept both."

omar: Can we add a tiny migration note under docs/migration/legacy-fields.md listing `uid -> user_id` and `ctx -> context`? That will help customers and SDK teams.

zane: I'll add the migration bullet and a short deprecation timeline. Also adding a docs CI smoke test that parses code blocks as JSON so these code examples don't drift. Link to test in PR description.

docs-bot: PR opened by kelly: #4456 "ingest API ref: canonicalize user_id + nullable metadata". CI queued.

kelly: Thanks — pinging @omar for review once CI passes. After merge we'll backport a short migration note to the 1.x branch.

omar: LGTM after small wording nit on the migration timeline.

zane: Nice work, thanks! :rocket:
